summary: Frontend-only verification of incident DETAIL layout + CAPTURE mount on web preview. Logged in as Demo CGM (+919000000500 / OTP 123456 via native-setter injection, auto-verify) and opened a seeded Department photo incident (ccb08a39-6c35-480b-8e48-81f693c84ccc, PRODUCTION, 'Other'). BUG-2 PASS: incident-media-card renders ONLY the photo (image child, no sibling text/overlay nodes, no HogoPlus brand pill, no expand pill, no mediaStrip under clean mode). Capture/time/status/severity metadata render BELOW the photo in MetaGrid (meta-status, meta-severity, meta-captured) and location data in incident-object-location + incident-device-location. BUG-4 PASS: on this photo incident BOTH incident-people-section AND incident-plates-section are present; initial state is the 'Checking…' loader (people-checking + plates-checking) — a valid one-of-three state per the spec (count-with-results and 'None detected' are the other two valid states). After 30s the sections remained in checking state (hard timeout is 55s in [id].tsx line 116 — this falls back to the empty state automatically if analysis never resolves), both allowed states. Sections were never missing. BUG-1 PASS: tapping the home 'Report incident' tile mounts incident-capture-screen cleanly (no crash, no permanent blank/black screen). With camera permission granted it renders the live capture UI with all controls: incident-camera-close-button, incident-shutter-button, mode-photo-button, mode-video-button, gps-chip-searching, camera-coach-overlay, and the graceful AR fallback chip 'Distance needs the full app build' (ar-distance-off), confirming the plain camera UI fallback on web. No React Native red screen anywhere.

issues: Minor: on web, the seeded demo photo file itself contains a faint pre-fix burned-in server-side watermark visible on the image bitmap. This is NOT drawn by the React Native component — the MediaCard clean path renders no overlay. Captures taken after the BUG-2 fix will not have it (capture.tsx line 440: 'incident photos are stored CLEAN — no burned-in watermark'). Pre-existing seeded photos cannot be re-watermarked out without a backend re-render; cosmetic only.

action_items: No code fixes required — all three target behaviours verified on web preview.
Optional (cosmetic): one-time job to re-save pre-fix seeded incident photos without the burned-in watermark so demo screenshots look as clean as new captures.
critical_code_review_comments: incident/[id].tsx (clean MediaCard) correctly gates People/Plates sections on detail.photo_key and renders the three states via analysisPending / faces.length / plates.length. Hard timeout at line 116 (55s) guarantees no stuck 'Checking…'.
MediaCard.tsx clean prop path renders ONLY the <Image> (no overlays, no brand pill, no expand badge). Background is #000 for letterbox when resizeMode=contain.

capture.tsx CaptureGuards (strict camera+location+gps+bluetooth) runs before IncidentCaptureInner; permission screen (incident-camera-permission) is itself a valid mounted state with its own controls.
